01 / Material scale

Matter.

Crystals, surfaces, cast forms and their shadows.

Observe material structure and the conditions under which it changes. The scale refers to the object being observed, rather than the size of the equipment.

Crystallization ↗

Matter finding a form.

Molybdomancy / cast-metal readings ↗

A solidified form and its shadow.

Hand scale / Reflective surfaces, fire & forms

Catoptromancy / mirror gazing ↗

Contemplating or interpreting images seen in a reflective surface, including a dark mirror.

◈
Matter / Reflective surfaces, fire & forms

Hydromancy ↗

Symbolic or divinatory interpretation of water, its surface, reflections or movement.

✧
Hand scale / Reflective surfaces, fire & forms

Lecanomancy ↗

A reading made with a basin, commonly involving water and sometimes floating substances such as oil.

◈
Matter / Reflective surfaces, fire & forms

Pyromancy ↗

Symbolic interpretation of fire, including the appearance or movement of a flame.

◈
Matter / Reflective surfaces, fire & forms

Capnomancy ↗

The symbolic interpretation of smoke, its direction, density or changing forms.

◈
Matter / Reflective surfaces, fire & forms

Ceromancy ↗

Symbolic interpretation of wax shapes, including cooled forms and candle remnants.

✧
Hand scale / Reflective surfaces, fire & forms

Lithomancy ↗

Readings made with stones or gems through selection, arrangement, casting or reflected light.

◈
Matter / Reflective surfaces, fire & forms

Sand readings / psammomancy ↗

Symbolic interpretation of patterns in sand, scattered grains or marks made on a granular surface.

◈
Matter / Reflective surfaces, fire & forms

Inkblot & incidental-image readings ↗

Symbolic responses to incidental marks, stains or ambiguous images, recorded as personal interpretations.

✧
Hand scale / Lots, texts, names & numbers

Geomancy ↗

A family of divinatory systems using generated figures, often formed from odd and even groups of marks.

◈
Matter / Landscape, weather & animal signs

Scapulimancy & plastromancy ↗

Historical oracle readings of shoulder blades and turtle plastrons, often involving cracks and inscriptions.

◈
Matter / Landscape, weather & animal signs

Extispicy / hepatoscopy ↗

Historical readings of internal organs, with hepatoscopy specifically concerning the liver.

✧
Hand scale / Branches of arts already present

Tasseography variants ↗

Related cup-reading practices interpreting patterns of tea leaves, coffee grounds or other specified sediment.
